newsitem.title: USA: Belo, Providence set merger shr price.
newsitem.headline: Belo, Providence set merger shr price.

text.p: A.H. Belo Corp and The Providence Journal Co said Thursday the valuation period stock price for purposes of the consideration to be paid in the merger of The Providence Journal Company into A.H. Belo Corp is $37.15 per share.
The companies said the figure is based on the average closing price of Belo Series A Common Stock from January 29 to February 11.

Based on this price, Providence Journal shareholders making an all-stock election will receive .8652 per share of A. H. Belo Series A Common Stock, and those making an all-cash election will receive $32.14 per share, a statement from Belo said.

Because the total number of shares of Belo stock to be issued in the merger and the total amount of cash to be paid in the merger are fixed, an all-stock or all-cash election may be subject to proration, the statement said.
